title: Slow Computers
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about what made a game slow down on an old PC. Level 1 has a short pad and a long pad: a sound was read from the disk whole before the game went on, so a long one froze the game while it loaded, and the music kept its own time. Level 2 puts 36 friendly monsters on one screen, which a 286 could not keep up with. Level 3 moves the whole sky every tick. A player with a speed setting can run it like a 286, a 386 or a 486 and see the difference. Signs and pages give the numbers as estimates, and tips for keeping a game fast. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a sound or count the monsters.

box.back: A small explorer finds three short rooms that show what slowed a game down on a 1994 PC: a long sound that freezes the game while it loads, a crowd of monsters, and a sky that moves every tick. A player with a speed setting can run it like a 286, a 386 or a 486. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a sound.
features: A short pad and a long pad: a sound has to be read from the disk
A sky that moves every tick
Made to be copied and taken apart
